critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/server.py upload_suppliers does `db.suppliers.delete_many({})` then `insert_many(items)` — this is a destructive replace. If the upload payload is empty or malformed, the existing 135 entries are still wiped before any insert. Recommend wrapping in a transaction or staging the new docs into a temp collection then renaming, so a partial failure doesn't leave the master list empty in production.

GET /api/employees and /api/suppliers return shape {items:[...], count:N} but the problem statement says each item shape — make sure the frontend SupplierCombo + EmployeeCombo unwrap data.items consistently (it does, verified live). Document this contract in an OpenAPI summary so future consumers don't assume a bare array.

i18n.js: button text 'Agregar subcontratista' (and similar) relies on CSS `text-transform: uppercase` for ALL CAPS rendering. This is fine visually, but copy/paste from the screen yields lowercase. Acceptable for now; flag for accessibility review (some screen readers announce both forms differently).

SupplierCombo + EmployeeCombo do free-text fallback per spec. Verified: typing a non-existent name leaves the input value as-typed. Good UX. Backend daily_reports endpoint accepts arbitrary subcontractors[].company strings (no validation against suppliers list) — acceptable given the 'one-off vendors' use-case but means typo'd names won't roll up to a clean supplier-of-record report. Recommend a fuzzy-match warning at PDF generation time.
conftest.py auto-injects X-Admin-Token via setdefault — unauthenticated tests must explicitly send `X-Admin-Token: ''` to bypass and prove gate. Documented in the new iter21 test file.
